name: text-along-path
title: Text Along Path
description: Letters of a repeating phrase run endlessly along an SVG path, by default a rounded rectangle that frames the picture; supply your own path to make it follow any curve.
useWhen: Text should circle the frame, a card or a shape like a ticker tape or a badge ring.
A repeating phrase needs to follow a curve, a circle or a custom outline.
avoidWhen: The text should move in a straight line: use infinite-marquee.
The text should be read once, not repeated: use a reveal block.
author: Daniel Petho

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Phrase that repeats along the path.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Text size in pixels (or in viewBox units when a custom path is given).

variables.label: Loop seconds
variables.description: Seconds the text takes to travel once around the path. The block lasts 6 seconds, so 6 plays one full seamless loop. The letter spacing stretches slightly so whole phrases fill a closed path exactly.

variables.label: Reverse
variables.description: Run the text the other way around.

variables.label: Margin
variables.description: Distance of the default rectangle from the frame edge, as a percentage of the shorter side.

variables.label: Corner radius
variables.description: Corner radius of the default rectangle, as a percentage of the shorter side.

variables.label: Custom path
variables.description: SVG path data (the d attribute) to run the text on. Empty uses the rounded rectangle.

variables.label: Custom viewBox
variables.description: viewBox of the custom path, for example 0 0 100 100. Ignored without a custom path.

variables.label: Show path
variables.description: Draw the path itself as a thin line.
